chips.title: Margin normalization and wrapped-line joining core
chips.summary: Conflict-based margin classifier, two-or-four-space base detection, and evidence-gated rejoining of terminal-wrapped lines, covered by the Core unit suite.

evidence.message: Initial tray utility scaffold and the introductory-slice specification landed on the first day of the repository.
The two-ratio margin gate was replaced with a conflict-based classifier; a column-zero first line is treated as a selection artifact.
Wrapped-line joining with the wrap signature and an unconditional join hotkey shipped as JOIN-001 through JOIN-005.
Joining now requires word-boundary evidence at the seams (JOIN-001a, JOIN-004a); the Core suite passes on main.

chips.title: Tray app, clipboard privacy policy, and resilience hardening
chips.summary: Tray-only WinForms app with owner-first source attribution, preserved clipboard privacy formats, plain-text-only rewrites, and five adversarial defects fixed and recorded.

evidence.message: Tray application, clipboard listener, single-instance guard, and configuration store were part of the initial scaffold.
Resilience run reproduced four defects (large items, hidden retries, stale overwrite, lost rich formats); all four were fixed in the installed build.
Clipboard history flyout freeze fixed by debouncing clipboard work off the notification path; the resilience report records the root cause.

chips.title: v0.1.0 release with installer, hosted CI, and closed installer runbook
chips.summary: Per-user installer with a Start-with-Windows toggle, hosted Windows CI, a tag-built release workflow, and the published 0.1.0 artifact with all fifteen runbook steps recorded.

evidence.message: Startup registration and the Start-with-Windows tray toggle landed alongside the first installer work.
Hosted Windows build-and-test workflow merged; local, pull-request, and main runs all passed the same 113 tests.
v0.1.0 tagged and built by the release workflow from the tagged commit, with a checksum published beside the unsigned installer.
Installer runbook steps 1-15 recorded on main, including reinstall-while-running against the published artifact; the box is back on the released build.

chips.title: v0.1 evidence-backed Windows proof
chips.summary: Automated baseline, installer runbook, and all nineteen manual clipboard cases are recorded against named builds; two defects the run found were fixed and reverified.

evidence.message: Proof plan defined against the implementation baseline: automated acceptance criteria, POC questions, and nineteen manual matrix steps.
Functional proof ledger moved into tracked docs so its unrun state is visible in a clone; installer proof and automated baseline are the recorded parts.
Repository review: no commits since the runbook closeout on 2026-08-29 and the working tree holds only an ignore-file edit; the manual matrix is still unrun.
Manual matrix run started with a guided driver; the stale baseline was rerun first and the first batch of cases passed.
Run findings fixed: contended clipboard reads are retried, and copies with no owner window are skipped instead of trusting the foreground app.
Proof ledger header closed: every case has a result; the remote-desktop case passed after restarting the remote clipboard helper.

chips.title: Prompt navigation bridge for Codex and Claude in Windows Terminal
chips.summary: Installed bridge repairs are confirmed in existing Codex and Claude sessions. Typing and caret behavior are normal; older damaged paint bounds navigation.

evidence.message: Navigation plan written and reviewed; the operator chose to keep existing agent launch commands and classic scrollback.
Opt-in Codex renderer bridge merged while the v0.1 manual ledger was still open; native terminal marks were found unsuitable.
Claude renderer navigation bundled with the Codex deployment; shortcuts moved to Alt+Shift comma and period with shell autostart.
Failed helpers are replaced with capped backoff, and Claude prompt anchors now survive conversation compaction.
Typing lag fixed by keeping bridge waits off input and stopping rescans on keystrokes; the operator confirmed typing and both shortcuts.
Stock Codex launch bypasses the installed bridge. Tests pass, but live navigation lacks stable focus; the failing launch path still needs confirmation.
Both clients fail. Dense scrollback reproduces scan timeouts; candidate repairs failed validation and were reverted. A scanner scope decision is requested.
Approved scanner rewrite passes both client input tests and dense mapping. Typing adds no scans; installation approval is requested.
Scanner repair passes both client tests and CI. Installing the verified bundle and refreshing running helpers awaits approval for files outside the project.
Verified scanner installed; four helpers restarted with CLI sessions intact. Input tests pass; native-session shortcut and typing confirmation is still needed.
Existing sessions still failed after rollout. Bounded history and confirmed-key fixes now pass tests and are installed; actual-session results are awaited.
Lugos Codex jump confirmed by Matt and viewport evidence. Claude has a missing closing marker; isolated renderer checks pass except the instant-reply case.
Matt confirms Claude navigation and normal typing after the installed recovery. Mouse flicker stopped; text caret behavior is being clarified.
Matt confirms navigation, normal typing, and normal caret blinking. Earlier flicker stopped without another renderer change; bridge repair is complete.

chips.title: Retire unreliable prompt navigation
chips.summary: Navigation retired. Qualification and tray integration cancelled; automatic loading disabled and helpers archived/stopped while preserving CLI sessions.

evidence.message: Derived from the open items in the navigation plan, proof report, and Claude qualification notes; tray integration has not started.
Matt approved retirement. Automatic loading disabled; helpers archived/stopped and CLI parents preserved. Source and backups retained.

chips.title: v0.1 proof report, spec sync, and the next release
chips.summary: Proof report, spec sync and installer dry run complete. Version selection, candidate qualification and publication remain outside this batch.

evidence.message: Derived from the completion criteria of the proof plan and the release checklist; the unreleased section of the changelog is empty.
Ledger is closed but no proof report exists yet; the unreleased changelog now holds image export, navigation, and two clipboard fixes.
Report reconciles 18 passes and M07 observation. All 276 tests pass; Release dry run and downloaded checksum verified. No tag or publication.

chips.title: Later: source fingerprints, focused-control detection, rich formats, signing
chips.summary: Source-fingerprint matrix, telling editor-integrated terminals from editor copies, a dedicated clipboard thread, rich-format normalization, and signed packaging.

evidence.message: Listed under planned next steps in the README together with moving clipboard work to a dedicated STA thread and tray last-action status.
Absorbed the rich-format and packaging ideas; the image-export experiment has since merged, so it is no longer a later item.
